Ontario Online Casinos Compared by Experts
Under AGCO rules, registered online casinos and their affiliates (or any third-party site) cannot publicly advertise bonuses, free spins or other inducements. For that reason this page does not list offers. Any promotions available to you are shown on the casino's own site or app - once you have an account and have agreed to receive them - so read the T&Cs there before you play.

Did You Know?
Online Slots Ontario
Online slots are the most popular online casino game category in Ontario. The best-rated games come from providers like Play'n GO, Games Global and Pragmatic Play. Classic slots like Rich Wilde and the Book of Dead and Sweet Bonanza as well as progressive slots like Maple Moolah, the Ontario-only jackpot from Games Global, remain well-known, but newer releases like Gates of Olympus Super Scatter and Sugar Rush 1000 are also drawing attention. But do keep in mind that every spin is random, and no spin or game can guarantee a win.

Live Dealer Games Ontario
Live dealer games remain a popular alternative to slots. The benefit of playing at a live dealer table is that you get the full casino experience from the comfort of your own home, with interaction with other players and dealers available through the chat function. Many live Evolution games feature special versions of standard table games and there are also game show-inspired games available to play too like Crazy Time.

Responsible Gambling in Ontario
Operators registered in Ontario are required to provide responsible gambling measures, such as: tools for players to set gaming limits, self-exclusion programs and ensuring that advertising does not target minors or vulnerable individuals. Gambling should be entertainment, not a way to "make money". Only play with money you can afford to lose and remember to take breaks. If the fun stops - stop.
ConnexOntario
ConnexOntario provides free and confidential support for anyone affected by problem gambling, among other addictions. You can reach the helpline 24/7 at 1-866-531-2600 or by visiting connexontario.ca. They can connect you with local treatment resources and support programs.
GameSense Ontario
GameSense Ontario provides information on how games work and explains key gambling concepts so you can make informed choices.
Self-Exclusion
Self-exclusion programs like BetGuard allow you to step away from gambling for a set period (chosen by yourself). With BetGuard you can set an exclusion that will prevent you from playing at Ontario casinos for six months, one year, or five years. You can also contact the Ontario Gambling Helpline for information about local problem gambling treatment resources.
Limit-Setting Tools at Ontario Casinos
- Deposit limits: Cap how much money you can put into your casino account over a set period.
- Loss limits: Set a ceiling on how much you can lose before play is restricted.
- Time limits: Control how long you can play in a single session.
- Bet limits: Restrict the size of individual wagers.
- Reality checks: Notifications that prompt you to take a break when you've been playing for a long time.
- Gambling history: A record of your activity to help you monitor deposits and losses over time.
